Write only specified output_dir ack.json/review.md/usage.json/delivery-readback.json and optional own reader-results.json
exec_command require_escalated for authorized repo report writes; same proven writer channel
No private namespace lookup or metadata enumeration; no retry guessing
exclusions: No A2 implementation or Q3/Q-P4 rereview; no new adjacent question
No claim loaded runtime/FullAccess/actual recovery/wholeF3/Release. Keep30skip accepted unverified, not passes, not Release.
